name: Tiko Talk
subtitle: Build sentences, tap to talk
promotional_text: From single words to full sentences. Tap word tiles to build a sentence, then tap speak to say the whole thing out loud.
description:
Tiko Talk helps children go from single words to full sentences. Tap word tiles to build a sentence in the strip at the top, then tap speak to say the whole thing out loud.

It is made for children who can recognise words but need help putting them together — including AAC users, children with speech delays, and young learners building a second language. Tiles are grouped so the next word is always easy to find, and gentle suggestions help each sentence grow.

Every child should be able to express a complete thought — not just label things, but say what they mean. Tiko Talk makes that as easy as tapping tiles.

• Tap word tiles to build a sentence step by step
• Speak the whole sentence, or tap a single word to hear it
• Choose a word cloud or grid layout
• Helpful word suggestions that guide the sentence forward
• Search for a word, or add your own
• Speaks in multiple languages

Tiko Talk opens straight into the board so a child can start building sentences right away.
